description: This file defines the ShoppingCartModelPopulator class, which converts ShoppingCartData objects into ShoppingCart model objects within a shopping cart context. It manages creating, updating, and synchronizing shopping cart entities with the underlying database, including handling of cart items, attributes, and associated product details.

classes.name: ShoppingCartModelPopulator
classes.description: A service class responsible for populating ShoppingCart entities from ShoppingCartData objects, handling create/update logic, item attribute management, and ensuring consistency with product and customer data.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts ShoppingCartData to ShoppingCart, updating or creating cart entities in the database, and handling cart items and attributes.

methods.name: createCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem entity from ShoppingCartItem data, linking it to products and attributes, and ensuring product belongs to the correct merchant store.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ShoppingCart.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Getter for the customer object associated with the populator.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Setter for the customer object associated with the populator.
